risks.risk: Snapshot persistence is single-process and whole-file: two app instances (or a container restarted mid-write on an exotic filesystem) can diverge
risks.mitigation: Documented in ADR-010; migration path is TD-006 (same store API on a real database)

risks.risk: Uploaded product images live on local disk (UPLOAD_DIR) and are lost if the deploy target is ephemeral
risks.mitigation: Documented in ADR-013; must be covered by backups (scripts/backup.sh) or moved to object storage (TD-007)

risks.risk: Live payment gateway and SMS panel credentials are still not configured
risks.mitigation: Code paths are complete and adapter-tested; ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID and KAVENEGAR_API_KEY are business-side inputs (deferred by the owner)

risks.risk: Accessibility gate is static (markup-level); contrast and screen-reader flow still need a manual pass
risks.mitigation: Noted in ADR-016; manual pass is item 10 of the ready-to-sell DoD

risks.risk: Kavenegar free-form SMS (sendMessage) may require a pre-approved pattern/template on the panel
risks.mitigation: Adapter isolates the call; template name is configuration, not code

nextRecommendedStep: Phase 11 options: (a) activate the live gateway/SMS credentials and run a real end-to-end purchase, (b) reporting/exports for wholesale partners, (c) move the storefront to a build step (TD-005) if SEO volume justifies it
